plain: Lacking self-control; living in a loose, immoral way.

webster.text: Loose in behavior and morals; given to vice and dissipation; wanton; lewd; luxurious; debauched; not under the restraints of law; as a dissolute man; dissolute company.

more.text: Vicious; wanton; devoted to pleasure and dissipation; as a dissolute life.

example.quote: The inhabitants of warmer climates are more dissolute in their manners, and less industrious, than in colder countries.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
